pinehurst-resort.shape: 1 round per night stayed, plus The Cradle
pinehurst-resort.includes: Room, breakfast daily and cart; classic courses Nos. 1, 3, 5–9
pinehurst-resort.detail: Hidden Gems package, fall 2026, sharing a room at the Holly Inn or Manor; No. 2 costs extra. Bed, Breakfast & Golf runs about 15% more.

sand-valley.detail: Lodge rooms in spring and fall 2025; summer is higher. Green fees are extra.

streamsong.shape: Resort-guest green fees $170–$395 a round, plus $35 cart
streamsong.detail: Fees run from $375 (Oct–mid-Dec 2026) and $395 (mid-Jan–Apr 2027) down to $170 in summer 2027. Rooms are extra.

big-cedar.includes: Lodging, all meals, Payne's Valley, Mountain Top, Ozarks National and Top of the Rock
big-cedar.detail: The Ultimate Big Cedar Golf Experience, set April dates in 2025.

pebble-fairway-escape.includes: Inn at Spanish Bay; one round each at Pebble Beach, Spyglass Hill and Spanish Bay; taxes and service charge included
pebble-fairway-escape.detail: Starting price from cagolf.com's listing of the same 3-night, 3-round package. 25% off a 4th night, 50% off a 5th; a second Pebble round needs a 6-night stay.

lb0c56640.shape: 1–3 nights; 18 at Pete Dye plus Donald Ross (and Sultan's Run on the 3-night)
lb0c56640.includes: Any resort hotel, carts, bag storage and shuttle
lb0c56640.detail: 2027 green fees: Pete Dye $500, Donald Ross $185. Call (844) 792-8333 for package rates. Forecaddie at Pete Dye $50 a round plus tip.

l2375399a.detail: 2027 green fees: Pete Dye $500, Donald Ross $185, if you'd rather book rounds one at a time.

l89e45ef2.includes: Room and unlimited golf on the East and West courses
l89e45ef2.detail: Rooms run from about $380 a night in winter and $390 in spring 2027; the golf package is priced when you book.

l671a42f4.includes: Room and unlimited golf on the Old Course and Cascades; also a 1-night, 1-round "Your Way" package
l671a42f4.detail: Offered through Dec 31, 2026; the resort prices it when you inquire.

ld617570f.includes: Room and unlimited golf on the River and Plantation courses
ld617570f.detail: Kingsmill Stay & Play from $247 per person a night on GolfPass.

ld0a51cc0.shape: 5 nights, unlimited golf Mon–Fri (Super 5); also 1-night Unlimited Golf and Stay & Play (a round per night)
ld0a51cc0.includes: Lodging, unlimited golf on The Alpine, Monument, Moor, Donald Ross Memorial, Crooked Tree; welcome party on Super 5
ld0a51cc0.detail: Michigan's Magnificent 11 adds The Heather and Arthur Hills. Call (855) 688-3286 for rates.

l96d473e4.shape: 1 round per golfer per night stayed
l96d473e4.includes: Room, $100 resort credit per room, range access; Crenshaw Cliffside or Palmer Lakeside
l96d473e4.detail: PGA TOUR Golf Package; priced by the resort's planners at 512-329-4018.

bandon-dunes.shape: Rooms by the night; golf booked per round
bandon-dunes.includes: Lodge, Inn, Chrome Lake and Grove cottage rooms
bandon-dunes.detail: 2026 rooms run $170 a night in Dec–Jan up to $380 in Jun–Sep (Lodge single), and $1,300–$2,300 for 4-bedroom Grove cottages and suites.

torrey-pines.includes: The Lodge at Torrey Pines, one round each on the South and North courses
torrey-pines.detail: Torrey Pines package from $465 per person a night on cagolf.com.

la-quinta.includes: La Quinta Resort, PGA West Stadium plus La Quinta Mountain and Dunes

cabot-citrus.shape: 25 prepaid rounds with preferred room rates (Apr 20–Oct 29, 2026); Florida-resident Escape package in Dec 2026
cabot-citrus.includes: Rounds on Karoo and Roost, preferred rates on stays, dining and recreation
cabot-citrus.detail: Prices are given when you inquire.

kiawah-groups.shape: Custom; the Kiawah Ryder Cup Experience is for 12+ golfers
kiawah-groups.includes: Rooms or villas, rounds on the Ocean Course, Turtle Point, Osprey Point, Cougar Point and Oak Point
kiawah-groups.detail: Priced by the resort's group team; the Villas and Sanctuary packages above have posted rates.

price.note: Golf only; lodging is priced separately.

shanty-creek.includes: Golf on The Legend, Cedar River, Schuss Mountain, Summit and Hawk's Eye
shanty-creek.detail: $90 covers the golf; lodging is priced separately.

lbf95fb72.shape: 2 nights; unlimited golf plus a Crosswater round per night
lbf95fb72.includes: Lodge Village room, unlimited golf on Meadows, Woodlands and Caldera Links, a Crosswater round per night, carts and range balls
lbf95fb72.detail: Up to 30% off; priced on request through Dec 31, 2026.

l8384d797.includes: Room at the day's best rate with two free rounds on The Brute or The Highlands, cart and range
l8384d797.detail: "Stay and Golf Free": spring (Apr 1–May 21) and fall (Oct 1–Nov 8) 2026; tee times before 10am or after 1pm.

l31edd3b0.includes: Hotel, Tower or Lodge room; Atunyote, Shenendoah and Kaluhyat; free golf at Sandstone Hollow; same-day replays
l31edd3b0.detail: Champions Package, May–October, booked in 2-night blocks. Atunyote replays $125.

ld8733929.includes: Lodging and rounds on Mystic Rock and Shepherd's Rock
ld8733929.detail: 10% off 3 nights, 20% off 4, 30% off 5 or more. Priced on request through 2026.
